synapse-pause-dedicated-idle.title: Pause the dedicated SQL pool when it is idle
synapse-pause-dedicated-idle.body: This estimate runs the Synapse dedicated SQL pool all month although the workload has idle stretches. Microsoft documents pausing and resuming dedicated SQL pool compute to reduce costs; compute is not billed while the pool is paused, but storage still is. Set the hours the pool really runs to see the saving.

citation.source: Quickstart: Pause and resume compute in dedicated SQL pool via the Azure portal
citation.quote: To reduce costs, you can pause and resume compute resources on-demand.

synapse-reserved-capacity-steady.title: Compare a reservation for the dedicated SQL pool
synapse-reserved-capacity-steady.body: This dedicated SQL pool is priced pay-as-you-go and is expected to run steadily for a year or longer and most hours of the month (a reservation is billed every hour even when the pool is paused). Compare a one-year or three-year reservation of the same data warehouse units.

citation.source: Save costs for Azure Synapse Analytics - Dedicated SQL pool (formerly SQL DW) charges with reserved capacity
citation.quote: You can save money with Azure Synapse Analytics - Dedicated SQL pool (formerly SQL DW) by committing to a reservation for your cDWU usage for a duration of one or three years.
